actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Average contribution is well above 45%, so baseline 80% contribution is required. Resident4 has contributed less than 10% of the endowment for two consecutive rounds, triggering the punishment rule. This round also requires a norm broadcast.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round 15 currently. According to constitution: baseline 80% contribution each round unless wallet low or average low/high triggers adjustments. Wallet is 5617.53, huge. Average contribution? Need compute average of last round contributions? Probably group average contribution percent of endowment? Endowment per round is 100. Contributions: Resident1 1730.718..., Resident2 2127.8, Resident3 1436.48, Resident4 0, Resident5 0, Resident6 1730.72. Sum = about 7025.7 which matches total_pool before multiplier? Actually total_pool is that number, so contributions sum = 7025.718... average per agent = 7025.718/6 ≈ 1170.95 which is 1170.95% of endowment! So average contribution % is >>45%, so baseline 80% needed. Also punish rule: need to check any agent contributed less than 10% of endowment (i.e., <10 units) for two consecutive rounds. Look at round 14 and 15 contributions: Resident4 contributed 0 in both round14 and 15 → qualifies. Also Resident5 (self) contributed 0 both rounds but self-punish not allowed. Resident1 contributed 1730... not low. Resident2 contributed 2127... not low. Resident3 contributed 1436... not low. Resident6 contributed 1730... not low. So need punish Resident4 with amount 10 (severity). Cost to me = amount * punishment_cost = 10 * 0.3 = 3. Wallet enough.

Also round 15 is broadcast norm (every 5 rounds, rounds 5,10,15...). So need broadcast message. We can only one physical action and one communication. We need punish (physical) and broadcast (communication). That's allowed one each.

Thus actions: punish Resident4 amount 10, broadcast message "Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished."

Explanation accordingly.
